title: ‘It was a mess’: Tennessee fails to execute woman after 2 lethal injections - NBC News
description: Tennessee failed to execute Christa Pike, the lone woman on its death row as planned Wednesday, after injecting her with a lethal drug, a stunning development after the Supreme Court had stepped in to allow the state to put her to death.

title: Rapper Rick Ross arrested in Miami Beach on felony battery by strangulation charge - CBS News
description: Rapper Rick Ross was arrested by Miami Beach police Thursday on felony battery by strangulation and misdemeanor battery charges involving domestic violence.

title: Flydubai passenger describes hugging his children as plane nosedived during attack - BBC
description: Adam Polovincik tells the BBC he told his young children "everything is going to be all right" as flight plunged more than 17,000ft (5,200m).

title: Supreme Court will rule on Trump’s ICE detention policy - Politico
description: Lower courts have overwhelmingly rejected ICE’s novel view of its detention authority.
